There are no axes, no axis labels, no units, no scale bars, no panel letters, no data points, no spectra, no micrographs and no legend anywhere in the image. The group therefore contains no materials-science content, no sample identification, no processing condition and no quantitative information, and it can neither support nor contradict any claim about Cu-rich phase or κ-carbide precipitation in Fe-28Mn-10Al-1C-3Cu austenitic low-density steel. It appears to be a layout/HTML extraction artefact captured alongside the paper rather than a study figure, and it should be treated as non-informative for materials data extraction.
